Agent Name: InformationExtraction_Expert  
Step Number: 3  
Reason for Mistake: The InformationExtraction_Expert made an error in Step 3 by stating that Amir-Abbas Hoveyda was the Prime Minister of Iran in April 1977. In reality, Amir-Abbas Hoveyda was arrested in 1975, and by April 1977, the Prime Minister was Jamshid Amouzegar. This error is significant because it directly affects the solution to the problem of identifying the correct Prime Minister of Iran during the specified time.
